explanation: Spectacle maker Hans Lipperhey applied for a Dutch patent in 1608. Galileo's improved versions revealed four moons circling Jupiter in 1610, proof that not everything orbits Earth.

claims.text: In 1609 Galileo built his own telescope, an instrument that had appeared in the Netherlands in 1608.
The barometer (1640s), the pendulum clock (1656) and the magnetic compass (centuries earlier) were not the instrument that appeared in the Netherlands in 1608.
Hans Lipperhey, a spectacle maker, applied for a Dutch patent on a telescope in 1608.
In 1610 Galileo discovered four moons orbiting Jupiter.
Moons orbiting Jupiter showed that not every body in the heavens orbits Earth.
